note: Written by the bench author BEFORE any matcher was run on it. English only. 3 paraphrases for each of bank entries b001-b020 (b021/b022 are not probed but are in the index). None reuses a bank paraphrase; vocabulary differs from the bank question and paraphrases where natural. distractors_tune: used to tune the threshold (<= 5 % wrong hits). distractors_heldout: extra, never used for tuning, only to check that the tuned threshold generalises.
